what: The definition, columns and grants of public.debates_public in production, read before migration 0018 was applied (and after 0016 and 0017). Schema only, no rows. 0018's rollback restores this definition; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW keeps the grants.
definition:
SELECT id,
    topic_slug,
    school,
    score,
    verdict,
    elo_before,
    elo_after,
    created_at,
    kind,
    parent_debate_id,
        CASE
            WHEN argument_public THEN argument
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS argument
   FROM debates d;
